notes.problem: Primitive camcorder; flat brown mid-tone room fails the bold test.
notes.fix: Model a real camcorder turned three-quarters to the lens and kill the room fill so only the window rake lights the table and transcript.

notes.problem: Primitive camcorder dominates; transcript small with its leader across its cover; brown mid tone wall.
notes.fix: Turn the camera so a lens faces the reader, bring the transcript forward into the window rake at 600 px or more, and drop the room fill.

notes.problem: Primitive camcorder, flat mid-brown wall, a tripod leg across a label.
notes.fix: Model a lens barrel and hood, light only the table from the window, move the label clear of the tripod.

notes.problem: Bench a thin band with mannequin-scale justices; source line on a plate.
notes.fix: Move the camera forward and lower and slide the lectern so the source line sits on dark carpet.

notes.problem: Dark plate behind the cite line over the transcript; tiny justices; empty floor.
notes.fix: Delete the cite wash, shift the lectern so the transcript clears the footer, lower the camera so the bench fills the middle third.

notes.problem: Source line on a plate over the lectern; justices read as mannequins.
notes.fix: Shift the lectern so the bottom left corner is dark floor for the source line.

notes.problem: Counter on a plate, transcript a plain block, empty left half.
notes.fix: Crop right so the counter sits on open sky and give the transcript its cover, posts and black back.

notes.problem: Plate behind the counter; transcript a plain box; flat lit window.
notes.fix: Remove the plate, cap the floodlight so the tower's corner falls dark behind the counter, give the window a mullioned glow.

notes.problem: Counter on a plate, face-down transcript reads as a box, a flat sea-like horizon.
notes.fix: Light the tower so its corner is dark behind the counter, turn the binder so its back and posts read, replace the flat plane.

notes.problem: A speckled window strip clipped at the top edge.
notes.fix: Pitch the camera down so the strip leaves the frame and seat the book on one tread.

notes.problem: Clipped window strip at the top edge; book bridges a nosing.
notes.fix: Pitch the camera down so the strip leaves the frame and seat the book on one tread.

notes.problem: A noisy strip of far windows at the top edge, a broad mid-brown field of treads.
notes.fix: Lower the horizon or crop the lights out, and narrow the door light to the top tread and the transcript.

notes.problem: Risers not dark, nosings flat stripes, transcript a white box, doors read as display cases.
notes.fix: Lower the key so risers fall into shadow, bevel the nosings, give the transcript its cover and posts.

notes.problem: Lower 60 percent an even mid-brown field of flat treads, transcript a small slab, doors read as lit boxes.
notes.fix: Drop the camera onto the bottom tread so the transcript fills a third of the width in a tight key pool and the treads outside it fall to black.

notes.problem: Two flat evenly lit planes with tan bars and a filled blue square that reads as a certification seal.
notes.fix: Rake the bench light low from the left, curl the leaves, and replace the filled square with a bare signature rule.

notes.problem: Evenly lit greeked bars on a box lectern, flat blue seal, flat rail tiles, no rake.
notes.fix: Rake a low bench light from the left so the far leaf falls into shadow; emboss the seal; bevel the rail in brushed brass.

notes.problem: Transcript about 45 px, flat stair side, dead bottom fifth.
notes.fix: Bring the stair's near end into the left third with a lower eye so the transcript reaches 120 px; cut joints into the side; tilt down to fill the bottom band.

notes.problem: The stair is an extruded block with a featureless right half.
notes.fix: Turn the lens further off the open end so 18 nosings span the width, shadow and joint the cheek, crop the blank slab.
